codex.norse.name: Norse Codex
codex.norse.shortDescription: Weathered stone, carved dark wood, forged iron, restrained knotwork, and the permanent Base Rune Script.
codex.norse.longDescription: The permanent founding Codex of Rune Scribe. Norse is always installed, always owned, and always available as the secure presentation fallback.

script.base-runes.name: Base Rune Script
script.base-runes.description: Rune Scribe’s original 32-symbol Unicode-portable visual alphabet.

relic.norse.runestone-tablet.name: Runestone Tablet
relic.norse.runestone-tablet.description: A broad weathered stone tablet with a dimensional iron-and-knotwork border and paired raven crest.

relic.norse.dragonwood-plaque.name: Dragonwood Plaque
relic.norse.dragonwood-plaque.description: A tall plaque of dark carved wood enclosed by forged iron and crowned by a sculpted dragon.

relic.norse.stormforged-stele.name: Stormforged Stele
relic.norse.stormforged-stele.description: A tall war-stele of weathered stone and blackened iron beneath a carved hammer crest.

seal.norse.valknut.name: Valknut Seal
seal.norse.valknut.description: An aged bronze medallion bearing a sculpted interlocked Valknut.

seal.norse.ravenshield.name: Ravenshield Seal
seal.norse.ravenshield.description: A forged shield medallion bearing a sculpted raven.

seal.norse.mjolnir.name: Mjolnir Seal
seal.norse.mjolnir.description: A relief medallion bearing the hammer Mjolnir.

seal.norse.wolkin.name: Wolkin Seal
seal.norse.wolkin.description: An aged medallion bearing a longship beneath the northern sky.

seal.norse.yggdrasil.name: Yggdrasil Seal
seal.norse.yggdrasil.description: A sculpted medallion bearing the world tree Yggdrasil.

seal.norse.berserk.name: Berserk Seal
seal.norse.berserk.description: A dark forged medallion bearing a battle-worn warrior mark.

frame.norse.carved-knotwork.name: Norse Mastery Frame
frame.norse.carved-knotwork.description: A carved silver-and-gold knotwork mastery border with sculpted corner ornaments.

crest.norse.raven-mastery.name: Raven Mastery Crest
crest.norse.raven-mastery.description: A weathered shield crest bearing a sculpted silver raven and restrained blue enamel.

background.norse.cold-sea-hall.name: Cold Sea and Ancient Hall
background.norse.cold-sea-hall.description: A cold northern sea, distant longship and fjord settlement, and an ancient timber hall under deep navy light.

title.norse.master-of-runes.name: Master of Runes
title.norse.master-of-runes.description: The mastery title granted with the Raven Mastery Crest.

requirements.achievement.correspondent: Establish your first bidirectional cipher relationship.
requirements.rule.codex.norse.echo-five: Decode five valid incoming messages presented with the Norse Codex.
requirements.rule.codex.norse.mastery: Complete the approved Norse mastery requirements.
